findings.quote: and the weight of that directness was heavier and kinder than any story could have been.
findings.claim: Marcos answering straight, when he has circled every question in the book, is the whole of the moment; the narrator then tells the reader what it was worth.
findings.fix: Cut the phrase; end the paragraph at what actually happened.

findings.quote: he meant it the way he meant it on the day he first asked
findings.claim: 'meant it' twice in nine words pulls the ear onto the construction and trips the read-aloud voice.

iterations.notes: 0 major, 0 minor; check_prose clean. Both findings resolved. The critic was asked three specific questions about new seams and cleared all three: the interior paragraph before the question shows rather than explains; the amber stone does not read badly against the list of river stones two lines later; and the ending lands better without the deleted paragraph than with it. It flagged 'the thyme that rose in a smell when you trod on it' as slightly nonstandard but judged the rhythm to carry it, and did not raise it as a finding.
